question: Was this game decided by luck or by my choices?
answer: The game was decided mostly by luck. You got two big misses on Hurricane and Leaf Storm, Fezandipiti got frozen and then crit by Ice Beam, and you took two critical hits from Great Tusk and Landorus; those hax swings flipped the mid-game. Your choices were also costly, e.g. staying in with Samurott into Landorus Earth Power and letting Kyurem stay in on Great Tusk, which gave p1 free momentum.
